ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scam: A Deep Dive into Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case and other instances of childcare fraud, following the money and exploring the entities involved.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the Feeding Our Future case and its connections to broader childcare fraud issues
questions: What were the methods used in the Feeding Our Future scam?
How widespread is childcare fraud across the US?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant pattern of fraud in the childcare sector, potentially leading to policy changes and accountability.
